mapper.select: SELECT oi.order_info_id, oi.order_date, oi.merchant_uid, oi.order_status_id, oi.order_status_comment, op.order_person_id, op.order_info_id, op.name, op.email, op.phone, op.zipcode, op.address, op.address_detail, doi.draft_order_info_id, doi.order_info_id, doi.draft_total_amount, doi.draft_total_quantity, os.status_id, os.status_code, os.status_name, os.description, os.is_final FROM order_info AS oi LEFT JOIN order_person AS op ON oi.order_info_id = op.order_info_id LEFT JOIN draft_order_info AS doi ON oi.order_info_id = doi.order_info_id LEFT JOIN order_status AS os ON oi.order_status_id = os.status_id WHERE oi.order_date BETWEEN #{startOfWeek} AND #{endOfWeek} AND os.status_id = #{statusId} AND oi.order_status_id=#{statusId} ORDER BY oi.order_info_id DESC
